name: Block for Openverse – Insert Free Stock Images and Media
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
The Block for Openverse plugin seamlessly integrates Openverse media content, including audio and images, into your WordPress site. Easily access a vast library of high-quality, freely licensed media to enhance your website’s visual and auditory appeal. With intuitive Gutenberg blocks, you can quickly add stunning visuals and captivating audio to your posts and pages. Unlock a world of creative possibilities and enrich your site’s content with Openverse media, all within the familiar WordPress environment.

Features

  • Select two media types: Choose from image or audio.
  • Show/Hide: Toggle the visibility of Title, Creator, and License Type.
  • Add links to images: Choose an image hyperlink and a title hyperlink.
  • Column selection: Choose the number of columns with device-specific accordion settings.
  • Set gap spacing: Adjust the column and row gaps.
  • Image border customization: Configure the image border.
  • Typography and color settings: Customize the typography and color for Title, Creator, and License Type.

How to use

  • First install the Block For Openverse plugin
  • Add the Block For Openverse block from the block category called “Widgets” in Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

Feedback

  • Liked that plugin? Hate it? Want a new feature? Send me some feedback

External services Openverse API

This plugin interacts with external services to provide its functionality. Below are the details of these services:

  • Purpose: The plugin integrates with the Openverse API to display media content. Users can select media through the plugin interface, and the selected media is displayed via the API.

  • Data Transmission: Users provide an email and a unique username during verification. The email includes a verification link from Openverse, which must be clicked to complete the verification process.

  • Service Provider: Openverse

  • Terms of Use: https://docs.openverse.org/terms_of_service.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://openverse.org/privacy

Note: Users should review the terms of use and privacy policy of Openverse to understand how their data is handled and ensure compliance with any applicable legal requirements.
sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Block For Openverse
  3. Click on the Block For Openverse to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Block For Openverse plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the block-directory.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Block For Openverse plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Block For Openverse free?

Yes, Block For Openverse is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
